corrections.original_statement: A New Mexico resident is also required to hold a New Mexico driver license.

source_support.locator_or_reason: Physical PDF page 4, registered extracted-text lines 3–5; read with the section context.

corrections.issue: The licensing paragraph addresses people operating vehicles; the standalone paraphrase also appears to require nondriving residents to hold a license.
corrections.proposed_statement: A driver who resides in New Mexico must hold a New Mexico driver license.

corrections.original_statement: An instructional permit authorizes driving under the supervision of a licensed driver aged at least twenty-one who can operate that vehicle type.

source_support.locator_or_reason: Physical PDF page 4, registered extracted-text lines 14–16; read with the section context.

corrections.issue: Can operate is weaker and less precise than being licensed for that vehicle type.
corrections.proposed_statement: An instructional permit allows driving with supervision by someone aged at least twenty-one who holds a license for that type of vehicle.

corrections.original_statement: A person aged fifteen or older seeking the instructional permit must attend an approved driver education course that includes DWI instruction and driving practice.

source_support.locator_or_reason: Physical PDF page 4, registered extracted-text lines 22–23; read with the section context.

corrections.issue: The paraphrase omits enrollment and the named approving authority, the Traffic Safety Bureau.
corrections.proposed_statement: For an instructional permit, an applicant aged at least fifteen must enroll in and attend driver education approved by the Traffic Safety Bureau, covering DWI and practice driving.

corrections.original_statement: The alternative supervising driver must be at least twenty-one and have held a license in this or another state for at least three years.

source_support.locator_or_reason: Physical PDF page 4, registered extracted-text lines 24–26; read with the section context.

corrections.issue: Alternative supervising driver is not self-contained; it does not identify the permit or the alternative to an approved instructor.
corrections.proposed_statement: For instructional-permit driving without an approved instructor beside the learner, the supervising licensed driver must be at least twenty-one and have held a license in New Mexico or another state for at least three years.

corrections.original_statement: Without a licensed adult aged twenty-one or older in the vehicle, a provisional driver may carry at most one nonfamily passenger younger than twenty-one.

source_support.locator_or_reason: Physical PDF page 4, registered extracted-text lines 29–32; read with the section context.

corrections.issue: Nonfamily broadens the exception from immediate family to all family relationships.
corrections.proposed_statement: Without a licensed driver aged at least twenty-one in the vehicle, a provisional driver may carry no more than one passenger younger than twenty-one from outside the driver’s immediate family.

corrections.original_statement: The learner’s parent or guardian certifies completion of the required driving practice.

source_support.locator_or_reason: Physical PDF page 4, registered extracted-text lines 33–36; read with the section context.

corrections.issue: The required practice is specifically the provisional-license driving-practice requirement; learner alone leaves the stage unclear.
corrections.proposed_statement: A provisional-license applicant’s parent or guardian must certify completion of the required driving practice.

corrections.original_statement: The earliest provisional-license age is fifteen years and six months after holding an instructional permit for six months.

source_support.locator_or_reason: Physical PDF page 4, registered extracted-text lines 38–39; read with the section context.

corrections.issue: The age phrase can read as an interval after holding the permit rather than an age plus a separate prerequisite.
corrections.proposed_statement: For a provisional license, the minimum age is fifteen years and six months, and the applicant must have held an instructional permit for six months.

corrections.original_statement: During the provisional period, an unrestricted-license applicant must have neither a guilty adjudication nor a pending offense involving alcohol or drugs.

source_support.locator_or_reason: Physical PDF page 5, registered extracted-text lines 22–23; read with the section context.

corrections.issue: Neither a guilty adjudication nor a pending offense involving alcohol or drugs can make the alcohol/drug qualifier attach only to the pending offense.
corrections.proposed_statement: During the provisional period, an unrestricted-license applicant must have neither a guilty adjudication for an alcohol- or drug-use offense nor a pending offense involving that use.
